verdicts.reason: A: text is readable and nothing collides, but the bottle sticks out of the top of its circle and almost touches the canvas edge. The headline is left-aligned while the NEW pill and the oversized Try It button are pushed to the right, which leaves a large empty area at the bottom left, so the layout has no clear grid. B: the white headline sits on the cream circle and runs into the dark bottle, so it is nearly unreadable. The Try It button also overlaps the bottle, which makes this layout unusable.
